question: Which of the following river of India is NOT a tributary of Damodar River?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Indrawati__**.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Damodar River is one of the most i**mportant Rivers In Eastern India,** flowing across the states of **Jharkhand and West Bengal**.
 
• **Earlier known as Sorrow of Bengal and Jharkhand**, Damodar is one of the most contaminated rivers in India.
 
• **The tributaries and sub tributaries of the Damodar** include **Konar, Barakar, Haharo, Bokaro, Ghari, Jamunia, Khadia, Guaia and Bhera.**
 
• The **biggest tributary of the Damodar River **is the Barakar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Indravati River**

 
• Indravati River is a tributary of the Godavari River.
 
• Its **starting point is found to be the Ghats of Dandakaranya range,** in the Kalahandi district of the state of **Odisha, **The River follows a westerly **path and enters Jagadalpur in the state of Chhattisgarh.**
 
• The river moves from here in a southern route, before eventually uniting with the Godavari at the borders of three states. They are the state of Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, and Andhra Pradesh.
